summary: Cabot Corporation filed an 8-K on August 14, 2026, reporting the execution of an underwriting agreement with Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, PNC, and U.S. Bancorp for the issuance of $350 million aggregate principal amount of 4.950% senior notes due 2029. The offering is a routine debt issuance under an existing automatic shelf registration statement on Form S-3ASR. The notes will be issued under a base indenture supplemented by a second supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee, with closing expected on or about August 21, 2026. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Watch for closing conditions and note pricing relative to market.
